adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces substantial new branching/looping behavior without any accompanying tests. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, `createAllCalendarEvents` is rewritten to iterate over `event.destinationCalendar` (now an array), conditionally fetch missing credentials from DB via `prisma.credential.findUnique`, and potentially create multiple events per destination or per integration type. In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `createEvent` now takes `credentialId` and selects a calendar by `destinationCalendar.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`, plus new “main host” calendar selection logic. The only test change in the diff is `apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts` updating an expected payload field (`destinationCalendar: null` -> `[]`), which does not exercise the new multi-destination loop, the DB credential fallback path, or the credentialId-matching calendar selection. This is a specific, diff-grounded test gap that could allow regressions (skipped/double-created events) to ship unnoticed.
